pr_title: ESQL: Fix unreleased block in topn
pr_body:
This fixes a bug in the topn operator where it'll fail to de-track blocks if there's a failure while building the results from topn.

Closes #101588

review_comments: I thought we should use `Block.Builder.buildAll`, but these builders are ResultBuilder.
